description: Find real sites that could promote a product as affiliates, before anyone signs in: LinkJolt reads the product's website, picks its two closest competitors, checks which blogs, newsletters and channels link to them with affiliate links, and returns the 5 best fits with why each fits, plus a private page with the rest. Takes about a minute; when it answers still searching, call it again with the same website (asking again costs nothing). Never returns an email address. Use it when someone asks who could promote their product or how to find affiliates for it.

competitors.description: Optional: one or two competitor websites to check instead of the ones LinkJolt reads from the site, comma separated
